# MTG Decklists
> Public Magic: The Gathering tournament decklists by format, archetype, and event.

Site: https://mtgdecklists.com/
Sitemap: https://mtgdecklists.com/sitemap.xml
Coverage: up to 400 lists per format from August–September 2026.

## Hubs
- Formats: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/
- Archetypes: https://mtgdecklists.com/archetypes/
- Tournaments: https://mtgdecklists.com/tournaments/
- Tier list: https://mtgdecklists.com/tier-list.html
- Rules / banlist: https://mtgdecklists.com/format.html
- Search: https://mtgdecklists.com/search.html

## Formats
- Standard: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/standard.html
- Modern: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/modern.html
- Pioneer: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/pioneer.html
- Commander: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/commander.html
- Legacy: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/legacy.html
- Vintage: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/vintage.html
- Pauper: https://mtgdecklists.com/formats/pauper.html
